intrusion_on_l14.statement: Exactly 4 tracks and 2 vias lie inside the H4 corner square, and they are exactly the PCIE_DN4_N / PCIE_DN5_P fan-out.
intrusion_on_l14.note: The north landings (139.480,59.450) and (138.320,60.050) are OUTSIDE the square (y < 73.9287) and are legal; it is the In4 column descending into the square and the In5 lane end that intrude.

provenance.conclusion: The intruding copper is the DN4/DN5 'input' (EAST_CHIP_TO_J2 / connector J2) lane-plan detour plus its landing column, i.e. L3 DRAWING geometry - not placement, and not anything k2_gen_v5.py can move.

premise_correction.corrected_premise: W2PRIME_EXECUTION_SPEC_v1 E5 assumes 'the connector set changes, so the board must be regenerated, not edited'. That is true for the connectors but FALSE for the DN fan: stage 2a copies the drawing byte-for-byte, so with an unchanged drawing a full chain rerun reproduces the identical DN fan and H4 keeps FAILING.
premise_correction.consequence: E6/E7 cannot reach 'C21 all-PASS' until the drawing is re-emitted. The missing step is a lane-plan re-emission (which is exactly the 'scheme-layer missing drawing' of #K2-346), and it must come BEFORE E5.

repair_constraint.rule: For every DN input lane whose column must cross the keepout band (lane pol-y >= 73.9287) the turnaround column_x must satisfy column_x + via_radius + margin <= keepout x0.
repair_constraint.applies_to: DN4_N (74.222), DN5_P (75.671), DN6_N (77.120), DN7_P (78.569) - the four deepest lanes.
repair_constraint.band_note: 4 columns at the existing 0.58 mm pitch need 1.74 mm; the clear band is 2.25 mm wide once DN7_P is allowed to move west of 136.0, so a re-spacing exists (e.g. 135.40 / 136.15 / 136.90 / 137.65 keeps pitch 0.75 and gives DN4_N a 0.104 mm edge margin).

length_coupling.statement: Moving a column west shortens BOTH the In5 lane and the F.Cu landing run (landing -> pad at x=135.0), i.e. ~2x the x-shift, AND it shrinks the only place where the length-matching serpentine can live (the gap between column_x and the pad at x=135.0).
length_coupling.why_local_nudges_failed: This is the mechanical reason behind the four exhausted local-push families (#K2-341/#K2-346): the corner can be cleared geometrically, but the same motion removes the length budget, so every push either broke connectivity or landed on foreign copper.
length_coupling.implication: The repair is a re-solve of {lane detour + landing column + length compensation}, not a coordinate nudge, and the re-emitted drawing must re-pass its own 18 closed-form predicates.

enablers_for_the_repair.manifest_is_endpoint_based: m13_v57_s1_page_manifest.json (FROZEN a8ef3ea8ecff99d7) contains only artifact/authority/basis/inputs_sha/n_pages/pages/tally; each page carries ENDPOINT anchors (chip pad + connector pad global coords) and no page-geometry hashes. So a fan-geometry-only re-emission that leaves every endpoint fixed keeps the frozen manifest byte-identical.
enablers_for_the_repair.spec_rev_is_a_new_file: project.yaml::spec_name points at SPEC_k2_v4.spec-rev-61.json; the frozen SPEC_k2_v4.json is untouched by a rev-62 file, so the H4 keepout leaf can be corrected WITHOUT touching a frozen source.
enablers_for_the_repair.L4_MAIN_override: the chain can be driven from a NEW drawing file via the L4_MAIN env var, so 段2a can consume the corrected drawing without overwriting the current one.
enablers_for_the_repair.moved_chip_would_break_the_freeze: Moving U6 would change the chip pad anchors -> new manifest -> frozen-set change. Keeping all endpoints fixed is what keeps this inside the freeze.
